tasks.subject: 1A Step 1: Scaffold Vite react-ts template and move files to repo root
tasks.description: Generate Vite react-ts template into /tmp/kwnto-scaffold, move relevant files to repo root. Set package name to kwnto, private: true. Do not hand-pin TS/ESLint versions.

tasks.subject: 1A Step 2: Install remaining dependencies
tasks.description: Install: react, react-dom, tailwindcss, zustand, @xyflow/react, pocketbase, vitest, @playwright/test. Run npx playwright install firefox chromium.

tasks.subject: 1A Step 3: Update .gitignore
tasks.description: Add node_modules/, dist/, .env, test-results/, playwright-report/, spike/realtime/results/ to .gitignore before first commit.

tasks.subject: 1A Step 4: Close checkpoint 1A - verify and commit
tasks.description: Verify npm ls --depth=0 exits 0, git status --short lists no path under node_modules/. Commit: chore: scaffold from the Vite template and install dependencies.

tasks.subject: 1B Step 5: Configure tsconfig, vite.config.ts, vitest.config.ts, index.css
tasks.description: tsconfig: strict, noUncheckedIndexedAccess, allowImportingTsExtensions. vite.config.ts: React + Tailwind plugins, proxy /api and /_ to KWNTO_PB_URL. index.css: @import tailwindcss. vitest.config.ts: 3 projects (unit, rules, container).

tasks.subject: 1B Step 6: Replace App.tsx with minimal h1
tasks.description: src/App.tsx renders only h1 KWNTO. Delete template logos and demo CSS.

tasks.subject: 1B Step 7: Write smoke test src/smoke.test.ts
tasks.description: Write smoke test that proves vitest runs TypeScript: total of [1,2,3].reduce is 6.

tasks.subject: 1B Step 8: Configure npm scripts
tasks.description: dev: vite. build: tsc -b && vite build. typecheck: tsc -b --noEmit. test:unit: vitest run --project unit.

tasks.subject: 1B Step 9: Close checkpoint 1B - verify and commit
tasks.description: Verify npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run build passes. Commit: chore: configure TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind and Vitest.

tasks.subject: 1C Step 10: Create .env.example
tasks.description: Add KWNTO_ADMIN_EMAIL= and KWNTO_ADMIN_PASSWORD= with comment that password must be 10+ characters.

tasks.subject: 1C Step 11: Write docs/decisions/0001-toolchain.md
tasks.description: Document each dependency with installed version, license, and one-line rationale. Note single-package layout and same-origin backend URL.

tasks.subject: 1C Step 12: Close checkpoint 1C - verify and commit
tasks.description: Verify both files exist and 0001-toolchain.md lists every dependency in package.json. Commit: docs: toolchain decision record and .env.example.
